user.title: Set up Reolink Manager
user.description: Choose the entries of the official Reolink integration (for example your Home Hub) that Reolink Manager should manage. The manager only reads what Home Assistant already knows from Reolink and never talks to the cameras itself.

data_description.reolink_entries: Each Home Hub, NVR or directly connected camera is its own entry.

reconfigure.title: Change Reolink entries
reconfigure.description: Choose which entries of the Reolink integration Reolink Manager should manage.

data_description.reolink_entries: Each Home Hub, NVR or directly connected camera is its own entry.

error.no_selection: Select at least one Reolink entry.

abort.no_reolink: The official Reolink integration is not set up. Set up Reolink first.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Reolink Manager is already set up.

data_description.devices: Leave empty to manage all devices of the selected Reolink entries.
data_description.detection_types: Only these detections appear in the card.
data_description.battery_low: From this level the battery counts as low.
data_description.battery_critical: From this level the battery counts as critical (at most as high as "low").
data_description.offline_delay: Battery cameras sometimes drop out briefly. The "offline" event only fires after this time. 0 = immediately.
data_description.events_enabled: Sends Home Assistant events such as reolink_manager_device_offline.
data_description.experimental_enabled: Master switch. Experimental features are untested. When on, a second step follows where you pick single features.

experimental.title: Experimental features
experimental.description: These features are untested. Pick what you want to test. Live view and gallery can wake battery cameras.

data.gallery_count: Number of gallery videos per camera
data.push_detections: Detections that trigger a push notification
data.push_cooldown: Lock time per camera and detection (seconds)
data.push_path: Dashboard path for tapping the notification

data_description.experimental_features: Only effective when the master switch is on.
data_description.gallery_count: The newest recordings in low resolution are loaded (1 to 20).
data_description.push_targets: Mobile app services (notify.mobile_app_…). Several possible. Empty = no push notifications. Effective with the "Push" feature.
data_description.push_detections: Only these detection types send a message.
data_description.push_cooldown: Within this time the same camera sends no second message for the same detection. 0 = no lock.
data_description.push_path: Dashboard containing the card, e.g. /lovelace/cameras. Tapping the notification opens the camera's live view there.

options.live: Live view in the camera popup (can wake battery cameras)
options.push: Push notification with image on detection

rescan.name: Rescan devices
rescan.description: Reads the devices and entities of the Reolink integration again.

check_update.name: Check for new version
check_update.description: Asks GitHub for a newer version of Reolink Manager.

refresh_device.name: Refresh camera
refresh_device.description: Triggers a full update of the Reolink entities. This wakes battery cameras and uses battery. Experimental.

experimental_disabled.message: This feature is experimental and not enabled.

unknown_device.message: The device is not managed by Reolink Manager.
